messages:
acme-infra: Hey team, after we flipped the new corporate proxy our Private deployment started failing calls to Redwood. Intermittent TLS handshake errors and occasional 401s. Started right after proxy cutover. Can you help?

sophie_support: Hi! Can you paste the exact curl output and which host you're hitting?

acme-infra: Repro with curl: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/llm``` Output shows: "* SSL: certificate verify failed: self signed certificate in certificate chain". 
We also ran: ```openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.example.com:443 -servername api.redwood.example.com``` and the cert presented has CN=Corp-Proxy and issuer=Corp Root CA.

andrew_oncall: That looks like TLS inspect / MITM by your proxy. Two common fixes: 1) add the Corp Root CA to the container/VM trust store, or 2) configure the proxy to bypass MITM for our domains (SNI passthrough / CONNECT).

acme-infra: We tried adding the CA at the host level but our app runs in an immutable container image that doesn't inherit host certs. Any container-side suggestions?

sophie_support: Either bake the CA into the image or have your init step import it. Examples: Alpine: ```apk add ca-certificates && cp corp.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && update-ca-certificates``` Ubuntu/Debian: ```apt-get install -y ca-certificates && cp corp.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && update-ca-certificates```. Alternatively, configure the proxy to not terminate TLS for `api.redwood.example.com` and `metrics.redwood.run`.

acme-infra: Also see intermittent DNS resolving to internal IPs that time out. We have split-horizon DNS. Could that be related?

marta_infra: Yes — split-horizon can cause hits. Our Private control plane and telemetry endpoints expect public resolvable addresses. If your DNS resolves `api.redwood.example.com` to an internal/blackhole address you'll see connection timeouts and token refresh failures (which can show up as 401s). If possible, set DNS so our Redwood domains resolve externally, or add explicit overrides to route public IPs through your egress path.

acme-infra: Repro steps we ran: 1) `curl -v` -> TLS verify failed, 2) `openssl s_client -servername api.redwood.example.com -connect <ip>:443` -> proxy cert, 3) `nslookup api.redwood.example.com` -> returns 10.10.200.5 (internal). Logs: `error connecting to telemetry: dial tcp: i/o timeout`.

andrew_oncall: Also check your firewall/egress allowlist. For Private deployments we recommend allowing outbound 443/53 to Redwood IP ranges and health-check IPs. If DNS resolves to public IPs but firewall blocks them you get similar failures. Also check for blocked UDP DNS responses if you rely on recursive DNS.

sophie_support: For the 401s specifically — confirm system time is in sync. JWTs will reject if the client clock is off by >5 minutes. Commands: `date` and `timedatectl status` or `chronyc tracking`.

acme-infra: We disabled TLS inspect for the domain and that fixed the cert errors — now calls succeed but latency jumped from ~50ms to ~800ms.

marta_infra: Latency increase usually means the proxy is routing traffic through a slow outbound path or doing per-request re-parenting. Recommendation: enable SNI passthrough for Redwood domains or configure persistent CONNECT tunnels/keepalive so TLS flows directly. Also consider bypassing proxy for those domains via `no_proxy` in app env. Example: `no_proxy=api.redwood.example.com,metrics.redwood.run`

sophie_support: If you'd like, we can validate connectivity from our side. We can run probes if you can temporarily allow egress to our test IP `191.0.2.45` for 48 hours. We'll only use it for connectivity checks.

acme-infra: Ok opening 191.0.2.45 for 48h. Testing now. :thumbsup:

sophie_support: Thanks — once the port is open we'll run the probe and share results. In parallel: 1) add corp CA to your container images, 2) fix split-horizon for Redwood domains or add DNS/route overrides, 3) ensure egress allowlist includes our ranges and keep NTP in sync. Those three usually clear the TLS + 401 + timeout combo.

acme-infra: Appreciate it — we'll follow these steps and report back. If probes show anything weird please ping here.
